newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria short-term lev deposit rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria short-term lev deposit rates fall.

text.p: The short-term interbank deposit rates fell on Thursday as supply of lev funds outweighed demand, dealers said.
"Banks' lev liquidity is very high which led to a fall in interbank rates," said a dealer.
Traders said that banks had enough free funds due to mark selling after the introduction of a currency board and a fixed exchange rate of 1,000 levs per mark on July 1.
Overnight interbank depo rates fell to 2.0-2.4 percent annual from Wednesday's 3.0-4.0 percent. Spot week rates also retreated to around 4.0-5.0 percent from 4.5-5.0 percent.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.28 percent on Wednesday against 2.84 percent on Tuesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank's simple annual main rate is set at 6.96 percent since July 14.
